name: Non-potable water-filter function-first design demonstrator
purpose: Conceptual bench-only device intended to process non-potable demonstration water, with a measurable function-first engineering specification, not for drinking or human consumption.

inputs.flow_source: unverified gravity feed or supervised low pressure

requirements.statement: Deliver at least 0.5 L/min over the defined bench challenge, at the measured test pressure and clean media condition.

verification.name: REQ_FLOW bench acceptance
verification.procedure: Instrument actual inlet and outlet flow, record media state, influent quality, pressure and uncertainty; no physical data available yet.

requirements.statement: Reduce specified test-particle turbidity by at least 70% in a controlled non-potable challenge (not a pathogen or health claim).

verification.name: REQ_PARTICLE bench acceptance
verification.procedure: Use calibrated turbidity measurements with sufficient challenge concentration, controls and repeat samples; report variability and any breakthrough.

requirements.statement: Keep wet path contained with no visible external leakage over the stipulated non-potable bench pressure-hold procedure.

verification.name: REQ_LEAK bench acceptance
verification.procedure: Select pressure rating and measured test pressure first; conduct supervised pressure/soak inspection on assembled, reviewed hardware.

requirements.statement: Ensure feed cannot bypass the selected filter medium unnoticed.

verification.name: REQ_BYPASS bench acceptance
verification.procedure: Inspect seal path, challenge with a visible tracer suitable for non-potable use, and document isolation and bypass results.

requirements.statement: Permit filter element replacement without contamination of the dry electrical enclosure.

verification.name: REQ_SERVICE bench acceptance
verification.procedure: Inspect maintenance geometry and demonstrate element replacement on a dry/unpowered fixture.

requirements.statement: Produce a clearly labelled inlet/outlet differential-pressure observation without asserting water quality from pressure alone.

verification.name: REQ_MONITOR bench acceptance
verification.procedure: Compare pressure observation to a calibrated reference over intended non-potable bench operating envelope.

requirements.statement: Prevent release or description of untested output as safe to drink.

verification.name: REQ_NONPOTABLE bench acceptance
verification.procedure: Review labels, device interface, evidence report and operator procedure; no drinking-water use authorized.

functions.name: Accept and convey inlet water
functions.description: Capture inlet, contain wet path and provide controlled head/flow.
functions.candidate_technology: rated tubing and inlet coupling not selected

functions.name: Separate challenge particulates
functions.description: Candidate passive filtration with pressure-dependent separation and potential clogging.
functions.physical_principle: size exclusion or verified adsorption selected from the challenge, not presumed
functions.candidate_technology: specific media and pore characteristics unselected

functions.name: Observe flow restriction
functions.candidate_technology: instrument type, range and isolation not selected

subsystems.name: Water inlet & containment
subsystems.purpose: Provide source fluid to treatment under controlled conditions

subsystems.name: Treatment element
subsystems.purpose: Process defined non-potable challenge, independently test performance

subsystems.name: Outlet and bypass isolation
subsystems.purpose: Route and contain output and prevent untreated bypass

subsystems.name: Differential pressure observation
subsystems.purpose: Measure pressure drop separately from actual water treatment

subsystems.name: Cartridge servicing and safety label
subsystems.purpose: Enable safe service and prevent drinking-water misrepresentation
